paragraphs.text: The Greensleeves Trilogy is a cycle of three books by Clayton Emery : Whispering Woods , Shattered Chains , and Final Sacrifice . This cycle tells the story of Greensleeves and her brother Gull .

This trilogy is also connected to the first Magic book, Arena , which is written by a different author. All together they are sometimes called " Garth /Greensleeves Cycle" or "Garth/Greensleeves Quadrilogy". They are set mainly on Aerona and Terisiare .
Arena tells the story happening approximately between 4069 and 4072 AR . The Greensleeves trilogy starts around 4073 AR and ends around 4077 AR.
